title: matelea carolinensis
intro: Matelea carolinensis, commonly known as "Coral Honeysuckle," is a flowering vine native to the southeastern United States. It is a type of plant that belongs to the Apocynaceae family and is known for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional folk medicine. The health benefits of Matelea carolinensis include its potential in reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health, while its therapeutic actions include its ability to lower blood pressure and reduce the risk of heart disease. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include alkaloids and iridoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
